name: Dongcheng DQU160 800W 160mm Heavy Duty Electric Paint & Mortar Mixer
shortDescription: High-torque 800W 550 RPM electric handheld paddle mixer with 160mm helical stirring paddle for homogeneous blending of paints, plaster, putty, and tile adhesive.
overview: The Dongcheng DQU160 is a dedicated high-torque electric paddle mixer engineered to replace strenuous, inefficient manual mixing of viscous construction compounds. Powered by an 800W low-speed, high-torque motor running at 550 RPM, it provides constant churning power without stalling in dense mixes like tile adhesives, wall putty, plaster, epoxy coatings, and heavy industrial enamels. The ergonomic double-D spade handle allows the operator to maintain firm two-handed leverage to counteract rotary mixing torque, preventing splashing and ensuring lump-free, perfectly homogenized mixtures in minutes.
keyFeatures: High-torque 800W motor with heavy reduction gearbox operating at 550 RPM
Includes heavy 160mm zinc-plated helical stirring paddle for bottom-up mixing
Ergonomic spade handle design provides balanced posture and torque control
Heavy-duty M14 threaded spindle ensures positive paddle connection
Lock-on button on power trigger allows continuous mixing without holding down switch
All-metal gear housing dissipates heat rapidly during continuous batch mixing
Suitable for medium-to-high viscosity compounds up to 50 kg batch volumes
applications: Mixing wall putty, gypsum plaster, and joint filler compounds
Blending ceramic and vitrified tile adhesives and grouts
Homogenizing heavy industrial paints, epoxies, and floor coatings
Preparing self-leveling floor compounds and repair mortars

1x 160mm Helical Mixing Paddle with Extension Rod
